last_etwap_base_supply.meaning: stored exponential TWAP base supply lastETWAPBaseSupply at market init

first_mint_updates_twap.meaning: whether the first mint updates the stored exponential TWAP before _checkMintCap enforces limits

followup_mint_possible.meaning: a follow-up mint after the first mint crosses the noCapLimit threshold is accepted rather than rejected by the mint cap check

market_frozen_interim.meaning: market remains effectively frozen in the interim until ETWAP recovers, with even a manual updateState taking ~30 minutes to grow ETWAP by 50%

assumptions: The first mint crosses the noCapLimit threshold and succeeds, leaving baseTokenSupply above the cap while ETWAP stays near zero.
The interim freeze is observable as the market being unable to accept follow-up mints/deposits until ETWAP recovers.
The ~30 minutes / 50% figures are approximate and implementation-dependent, so they are not encoded as numeric bounds.

unresolved.description: Report does not fully specify whether the first mint itself succeeds or is also capped, which affects the exact interim state in which the freeze occurs.
The '~30 minutes to grow ETWAP by 50%' recovery duration is approximate and implementation-dependent; no exact numeric relation is stated.

limitations: The freeze is encoded as a grounded Boolean observable because the report states the qualitative interim-frozen condition without an exact numeric definition.
The recovery-time magnitudes are retained in the symbol meaning but not formalized as numeric bounds.
Only the i_market_frozen_interim impact is formalized; other impacts are handled in separate passes.
